description: `measures-health validate scenario <name> --json` emits an expected/covered/waived report per scenario with a per-measure tier (full/partial/fallback) and a pass/fail verdict, where an uncovered stateful domain is an ERROR and a stale waiver pointing at a non-stateful or nonexistent domain is a WARNING, matching cli-health expected/covered/waived semantics.

requirements.description: Implement `measures-health validate scenario <name> --json` CLI command that emits a structured JSON report containing expected, covered, and waived measure counts per scenario. The report must include a per-measure tier classification (full/partial/fallback) and an overall pass/fail verdict. An uncovered stateful domain must be classified as ERROR severity. A stale waiver referencing a non-stateful or nonexistent domain must be classified as WARNING severity. The output schema must mirror cli-health expected/covered/waived semantics exactly.
requirements.title: Static Coverage Validation CLI Command

validation.notes: Go table test: given a scenario manifest with a stateful domain and no corresponding measure block, the validator classifies the domain as uncovered and emits ERROR
Go table test: given a waiver pointing to a domain that does not exist or is not stateful, the validator emits WARNING for a stale waiver
Go table test: coverage classification produces correct tier (full/partial/fallback) for each measure block based on endpoint presence and result-shape conformance
Go table test: pass verdict is emitted when all stateful domains are covered or waived with valid waivers; fail verdict is emitted when any ERROR is present
Go table test: domain-derivation logic correctly filters domains by substrate from proto/schemas/<scenario>/v1/domain/*.proto, and manifest measures.domains[]/omitted[] overrides are applied

Boot the real measures-health API binary; shell `measures-health validate scenario <fixture-scenario> --json`; assert the JSON output parses as the expected proto shape with expected/covered/waived fields populated
Run validate against a fixture scenario with a known uncovered stateful domain; assert exit code is non-zero and JSON contains at least one ERROR finding
Run validate against a fixture scenario with a stale waiver; assert JSON contains at least one WARNING finding and overall verdict is pass if no ERRORs exist
Harvest and validate all scenario manifests' measure blocks completes within 30 seconds on CI hardware for a fleet of up to 50 scenarios
Output JSON schema is identical in field naming and nesting to cli-health expected/covered/waived report shape, verified by schema comparison test

title: Static Coverage Validation
